row:
Hi, I'm Dr. Ask – a cat-only veterinarian since 2004. Welcome to my Cat Channel, where we explore everything feline: nutrition, health, behavior, and all the delightful quirks that make cats so unique.

My journey with cats began early with Flicka, my family’s Siamese, who claimed my crib as her sleeping spot. That bond sparked a lifelong passion that led me to veterinary school at Cornell University, where I graduated in 2004. Since then, I've worked in multiple feline-exclusive hospitals and proudly started my cat-only hospital in 2008.

With decades of experience treating cats and guiding their humans, I’m excited to share what I’ve learned. Whether you’re a devoted cat parent or simply cat-curious, join me as we celebrate, demystify, and enjoy the weird and wonderful world of cats.
